Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

We acknowledge your offer and the cost context provided. In line with your approval requirements, please submit our price proposal to your pricing committee for approval; we also seek a longer agreement, extended payment terms and greater call-off flexibility.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 4580 units per year for 36 months, 13740 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 427.22 per unit, 90 days net, 36-month contract, 4580 units per year. This amounts to about EUR 5870003 over the term.
3. Basis: On 2026-09-05 you quoted us EUR 412.74 per unit for this part; your new quote is 6.2% above it. Our should-cost estimate for Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020). Our demand forecast for this part is up +10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09). Producer prices DE: electronic components changed -2.3% from 2025-01 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C2611@2025-01, idx:PPI-C2611@2025-10).
4. Next step: You told us that price changes above 2% need your pricing committee. Please put this proposal to your pricing committee: a binding 36-month agreement for 13740 units, about EUR 5870003. On the committee's written confirmation we issue the order the same day, and we pay every invoice on the due date.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data, volume change data, and should cost data you cited; all hold and we took them into account. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. That remains. CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.

Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We are prepared to accept the requested 36-month contract term for 4580 units per year to ensure long-term supply stability.

Our updated Angebot is a price of €431.67 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net, we offer a price of €428.74 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Legal Department: Please note that our general terms and conditions apply to this process, and the quote lists our standard terms accordingly.

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
